Original bracket-matrix checker independently exhausts F_5, F_7 and F_25 and tests larger primes. No unstated infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The all-power adjoint ranks determine an entire representation-theoretic Jordan invariant across all primes p>3 and all coefficient fields. Filtration valuation alone rigidly determines this invariant on the natural Borel nilradical, whereas the full-Witt example exhibits resonance invisible to the known centralizer dimension. This supplies a natural uniform classification and a meaningful sharp representation boundary; the exact finite-field distribution counts the entire object, not a selective slice.
